digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler integration oracle / test harness
propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but clear_absent and siblings were moved to binding_lifecycle module during RP-02 S2 T2, so they now resolve their own _now_iso and bypass the frozen clock.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is not consulted on a healthy pass, but the blast radius narrowed and would miss regressions that unconditionally stamp updated_at in moved operations.
Patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle restores the oracle's original reach to detect timestamp stamping violations across all binding operations.

The clear_absent operation is structurally unreachable on healthy in-window passes (only invoked on out-of-window keys), making integration-tier mutation verification of its no-stamp contract impossible without test harness extensions.
